|colspan=2|
{{#cargo_query:tables=Hero=H, Hero__start_skills=S, Hero__start_skill_levels=L
| join on=H._rowID=S._rowID, S._rowID=L._rowID, S._position=L._position
| fields= S._value=id, L._value=level, CONCAT('{{{lang|en}}}') = lang
| where=H.id='{{{id|}}}'
| order by=S._position
| format=template
| template=SkillDisplay
| named args= yes
| delimiter=\n\n
}}

|-style="border-bottom: 1px solid #BCB096;border-top: 1px solid #BCB096; background-color:#1E3758"
|colspan=2|{{Link|type=ui|id=starting_spells|link=Spells|lang={{{lang}}}}}
|-style='border-bottom: 1px solid #BCB096'
|colspan=2, style='color: white;border: 1px solid #BCB096; padding:4px;'|
{{#cargo_query:tables=Hero=H, Hero__start_magics=S
| join on=H._rowID=S._rowID
| fields= S._value=id, CONCAT('{{{lang|en}}}') = lang
| where=H.id='{{{id|}}}'
| format=template
| template=SpellDisplay
| named args= yes
| delimiter=\n\n
}}

|-style='border-bottom: 1px solid #BCB096; background-color:#1E3758'
|colspan=2|{{Link|type=ui|id=starting_army|lang={{{lang}}}|nolink}}
|-style='border-bottom: 1px solid #BCB096'
|colspan=2|
{|<div style="text-align:center;">
|style="width:25%;"|
{{#cargo_query:
 tables  = Hero=H, HeroStartSquad=HSS, Unit=U,
           Translation=unit_t, Translation=unit_en
|join on = H.id         = HSS.hero_id, 
           HSS.unit_id  = U.id,
           U.id         = unit_t.target_id,
           U.id         = unit_en.target_id
|where   = H.id = '{{{id|}}}'
           AND HSS.variant     = 'primary'
           AND unit_t.type     = 'unit'       AND unit_t.language    = '{{{lang|en}}}'
           AND unit_en.type    = 'unit'       AND unit_en.language   = 'en'
|fields  = unit_t.name                          = name,
           unit_en.name                         = pagelink,
           CONCAT(unit_en.name, '_icon')        = filename,
           IF(HSS.min = HSS.max, HSS.min, 
               CONCAT(HSS.min, " - ", HSS.max)) = text
|order by= HSS.slot
|format  = template
|template= MediumIconThumbDisplay
|named args = yes
}}
</div>
|}
